tasks.short: Develop electronic-property changes that improve component or system performance.

steps.what: Diagnose the performance limit and define candidate electronic-property changes
outputs: engineer candidate property changes and evaluation criteria

steps.what: Build and check simulation models, parameter ranges and test conditions
inputs: engineer candidate property changes and evaluation criteria

steps.what: Run checked property sweeps and collect solver outputs into comparison plots
outputs: traceable candidate solver outputs and plots

steps.what: Interpret candidate performance and verify modelling limits against actual behaviour
inputs: traceable candidate solver outputs and plots

steps.what: Develop the chosen circuit modification and its application details
Document and approve the complete modification proposal and verification limits
Commit the approved modification proposal to controlled engineering records

tasks.design: Use native EDA solver batch sweeps and plot export ({OTHER}) for engineer-defined candidate changes. Keep model setup, physical interpretation, design development and proposal writing human. Save the final approved proposal through the existing engineering record control, also {OTHER}; it does not release a manufacturing design or change equipment.
tasks.previous_blocker: A solver cannot establish a valid component model or choose a useful physical modification.
tasks.enabler_now: Native batch studies can execute checked parameter sets and assemble comparable outputs.
tasks.still_hard: Model validity, parasitics and real performance require engineering reasoning.
tasks.human_edge: Reject a simulated improvement that depends on an invalid device or operating assumption.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated solver operation; retained electronic design judgement.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: electronic design tools support parameter sweeps and solver output plots for explicitly configured circuit models.

assumptions: Shares are provisional. Validate current manual run setup repetition and plot collection, not solver runtime. Existing automated sweeps earn no new benefit.

Engineer produces circuit/model revision, component properties, ranges, operating conditions, solver settings and acceptance criteria in s1/s2 at full time. Component-model sources are verified there; unknown models require manual investigation rather than generated properties. s3 only runs isolated study copies, not production assets.

s4 retains measurement comparison and model interpretation; s5 retains modification development. s6 documents/checks the complete proposal before a1 binds the final version and controlled destination. Any edit revokes approval. Native EDA and record features precede code.
research_questions: Which repeated solver operations remain after using the EDA tools native parameter studies?

incremental.description: Maintain solver study mappings and output checks

approvals.approved_version: s6 complete modification proposal and controlled destination

tasks.short: Prepare engineering sketches and installation or construction specifications.

steps.what: Verify site interfaces, equipment requirements and source drawing revisions
Design the layout, connections, clearances and equipment installation details
Create sketches using checked CAD blocks, model views and equipment schedules
Write specifications using selected clauses and exact equipment metadata
Check and approve the complete sketches, specifications, revisions and issue recipients
outputs: approved final engineering sketch and specification package

steps.what: Commit the approved engineering package to controlled document storage
inputs: approved final engineering sketch and specification package

steps.what: Send the approved engineering package to the internal project review team
inputs: approved final engineering sketch and specification package

tasks.design: Use native CAD blocks/views ({OTHER}) and controlled specification templates in {DOCS}. Retain design and interface investigation; reduce only repeated drawing placement and exact metadata/approved-clause insertion. Engineer checks the final complete package before separate controlled filing and internal issue actions. {OTHER} also represents existing engineering document control.
tasks.previous_blocker: Reusable drawing elements do not establish correct site interfaces or applicable specification clauses.
tasks.enabler_now: Native CAD reuse and controlled templates reduce repeated drafting from checked design decisions.
tasks.still_hard: Connection detail, clearances and constructability remain engineering work.
tasks.human_edge: Notice that a standard detail conflicts with the real installation.
tasks.altitude: Less repeat drafting with unchanged design and final technical review.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: CAD libraries and controlled document templates can reuse checked geometry and equipment metadata without deciding installation design.

assumptions: Shares are provisional; inspect actual repeated drafting and filing work. Existing CAD blocks/templates earn no new benefit.

Engineer produces/checks equipment IDs, dimensions, interfaces, connection details, clearances and source revisions in s1/s2 at full time. Existing library owner supplies approved blocks/clauses; engineer selects and checks applicability during retained s3/s4 time. Missing library items are drafted manually, not generated as verified details.
s3 retains 8 hours per provisional 100 for block placement, adaptation and corrections; s4 retains 12 for substantive specifications and clause selection. Final technical check s5 stays full time.

a1 binds final package/revision and storage; a2 binds final package/revision and internal recipients after s5. Edits revoke both. This is an internal review issue; external construction release requires its actual separate authority. Native features precede code.
research_questions: Which repetitive drafting remains after current CAD blocks and controlled clauses are applied?

outputs: checked engineering estimate and expenditure fields

tasks.design: Use existing {SPREADSHEET}/{ERP} estimate arithmetic and variance views for checked equipment/installation quantities, actual quotations and actual commitments. {OTHER} is the existing engineering design/BOM tool. Keep scope judgement, capture, contingency and control decisions full time. The final report is approved before separate filing and internal send; this does not authorise purchases, change the ledger or set a new budget.
tasks.previous_blocker: A price total is misleading when installation scope or actual commitments are missing.
tasks.enabler_now: Native estimate tables and ledger exports can calculate transparent line totals and variances.
tasks.still_hard: Scope gaps, uncertain labour and corrective choices require engineering and commercial judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise an omitted installation dependency before accepting a deceptively low estimate.
tasks.altitude: Less estimate arithmetic with retained cost-control decisions.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: estimate tables can multiply checked quantities by prices and compare recorded commitments with approved budget lines.

assumptions: Shares are provisional. Check actual manual estimate and variance work; existing formula/ERP functionality earns no new saving.

Engineer produces equipment and installation quantities in s1; suppliers produce actual quotations; finance owns existing approved labour rates, budget and ledger/commitment exports. s2 engineer captures/checks item_id, quantity, unit, price, currency, quote_expiry, labour_allowance, rate_basis, budget_line and commitment references at full time. Missing rates or scope require retained manual investigation, never guessed prices.

s3 applies declared formulas and line mappings only. s4 retains contingency setting, uncertainty and proposed corrective decisions. s5 writes/checks final report and assumptions before a1/a2 bind complete versions and their destinations.
No purchase, payment, budget approval or expenditure cancellation is silently executed. Native estimate/variance features precede custom code; no AI cost judgement.
research_questions: Which manual estimate and variance calculations remain after current ERP and spreadsheet functions?

tasks.short: Investigate greener electronics, power-saving devices and efficient chargers.

steps.what: Define the device energy problem and investigation criteria
inputs: actual device requirements and energy observations

steps.what: Find candidate device methods using engineer-maintained technical-library searches
inputs: existing licensed technical library and manufacturer documents

steps.what: Read candidates and evaluate circuit applicability, measurement claims and operating conditions
inputs: actual device requirements and energy observations

steps.what: Design the device experiment and its measurement conditions
Perform the bench investigation and interpret actual power and behaviour measurements
outputs: actual green-electronics measurements and engineer conclusions

steps.what: Write and approve the findings record with actual measurements and limitations
inputs: actual green-electronics measurements and engineer conclusions

steps.what: File the approved investigation findings and source references

tasks.design: Configure saved field searches in the existing licensed technical-library system ({OTHER}) for the engineers explicitly chosen device problem. Retain source reading, circuit assessment, experiment design, physical investigation, interpretation and findings writing. File the actual completed findings only after approval. Search results are leads, not verified device performance.
tasks.previous_blocker: Promising efficiency claims often use different load or standby conditions.
tasks.enabler_now: Native saved searches reduce repeated query/navigation work while keeping the original sources available.
tasks.still_hard: Applicability and actual device behaviour require electronics expertise and bench work.
tasks.human_edge: Design a test that exposes whether an efficiency claim holds for the intended device use.
tasks.altitude: Less literature navigation with unchanged investigation and physical validation.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: technical libraries support saved field searches and direct access to source documents; this does not validate electronics performance claims.

assumptions: Shares are provisional. Establish actual repeated library navigation and filing; existing saved searches earn no new benefit. No claimed device power savings are invented.

Engineer produces question, terms, exclusions and search fields in s1 and retained s2 time. Existing library supplies indexed document metadata and full texts; no free tagging or model-made conclusions. s2 retains 12 hours for query choice, relevance screening and missing-source retrieval. Missing coverage returns to manual search.

s3/s4 retain full reading and experiment setup. Engineer/instruments produce actual measurements in s5; s6 separately captures device_revision, test_conditions, instrument_reference, measured_values, units, interpretation and limits at full time. Actual results are not assumed from the planned test.
a1 binds the complete checked findings and source references after s6; edits revoke approval. Native searches/document storage precede code; no automatic publication or hardware change.
research_questions: Which repeated source-finding operations remain once the current library uses the engineers chosen search fields?

incremental.description: Maintain investigation search terms and library coverage checks

approvals.approved_version: s6 complete actual investigation findings and source references
